name: Purpose

subjectOf.text: Long run stability of a decentralized organization requires the momentum gained from a clear history, but momentum is not sufficient: if the system is not moving toward a healthy and productive goal it will not last long.
subjectOf.abstract: To keep a decentralized organization stable in the long run, they need this mo- mentum gained from a clear history. But momentum toward what purpose? If the system is not moving toward a healthy and productive goal, it will not last long.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of History In Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782217
scope_conditions: long run survival of decentralized organizations

subjectOf.text: The most important aspect of a decentralized organization, and the feature that ultimately determines its long term success, is the group's set of transcendental values.
